description: Pittsburgh Regional Transit Schedule Period Lookup is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Pittsburgh Regional Transit makes schedule adjustments quarterly. These schedule adjustments are called "picks" and correspond with operators picking their assignments. The data in this dataset is pulled from the PRT Period Schedule Lookup - Historical dataset on the PRT's data portal on a weekly basis. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Pittsburgh Regional Transit. Its tags are 1711, 1803, 1806, 1809, 1811. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
